description: 🌙 Lunar Minds is a team passionate about AI, Data Science, software, and space exploration. We're taking on NASA's “Flame in Freefall” challenge to build an AI-powered platform for exploring microgravity combustion research and fire-safety insights. 🚀 We're looking for teammates skilled in AI/ML, Python, Data Science, Web Development, UI/UX, Statistics, Space Science, or Research. 🌎 Open to participants worldwide!
